editorial.blurb: Kimchi Pop brings genuine Korean comfort to Lincoln Square with generous portions, fresh ingredients, and a warm, no-fuss atmosphere that keeps locals coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Go during off-peak hours if you can—service gets busy during peak times, but the quality makes any wait worthwhile, and the owner is notably generous with portions.
